fields.label: WooCommerce URL
fields.description: Base URL of the WooCommerce website. Required when the integration is enabled.

fields.label: Consumer Key
fields.description: WooCommerce API consumer key. Stored encrypted and never exposed to the browser.

fields.label: Consumer Secret
fields.description: WooCommerce API consumer secret. Stored encrypted and never exposed to the browser.

fields.label: API Path
fields.description: REST API path for order fulfillment. Must start with a forward slash.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Enable the WooCommerce order fulfillment integration.
